children: FOS reported that NBA star LeBron James has a commercial contract with prediction market platform Polymarket worth $15 million a year, sparking debate among the community and fans. According to Odaily, journalist Siegel said NBA players' outside business deals do not necessarily violate the current collective bargaining agreement, but future arrangements could resemble salary cap circumvention if players accept lower NBA contracts because of off-court income. Siegel added that the NBA is likely to pay closer attention if outside earnings and team payrolls become clearly linked.

title: Siegel Says LeBron James-Polymarket Deal Could Draw NBA Salary Cap Scrutiny
